canonical_project: AzInTelecom Hajigabul Reserve Data Center, Modules M1 and M2
notes: APA reported on 2025-10-14 that AzInTelecom had started construction of two new national data centers in 2025, with the Hajigabul facility expected to be finalized in 2029. EIB's 2024-12-23 press release confirms EUR43m financing for two AzInTelecom data centers in Absheron and Hajigabul, and Uptime Institute lists Hajigabul Reserve Data Center, Modules M1 and M2 at Pirsaat, Azerbaijan with Tier III design certification. No public MW capacity found.
